This is an [R Markdown](http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com) Notebook. When you execute code within the notebook, the results appear beneath the code. 

Try executing this chunk by clicking the *Run* button within the chunk or by placing your cursor inside it and pressing *Cmd+Shift+Enter*. 

```{r}
# Install and load required libraries
# install.packages(c("elevatr", "sf"))
library(tidyverse)
library(elevatr)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
# Load data
nsw_gliders <- read_csv("~/Downloads/BioNet_Atlas_species_sightings_20260930_121402/BioNet_Atlas_species_sightings_20260930_121402.csv")

# Convert to a spatial sf object using WGS84 projection (EPSG:4326)
nsw_gliders_sf <- st_as_sf(nsw_gliders, coords = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"), crs = 4283)

```

```{r}
# Extract elevation data (returns an sf object with an 'elevation' column)
nsw_gliders_elevation_data <- get_elev_point(nsw_gliders_sf, src = "aws")

# View results
# print(nsw_gliders_elevation_data)
```

```{r}
nsw_gliders_elevation_data |>
  arrange(desc(elevation)) -> nsw_gliders_elevation_data
```

```{r}
nsw_gliders_elevation_data |>
  mutate(pct_rank = percent_rank(elevation)) -> nsw_gliders_elevation_data
```
